Thanks — I'll take lead on the redlines. Quick clarifying questions before I prepare the first pass:

1) Data residency: ACME mentioned "US-only". Do they require contractually binding language (e.g., "Customer Data stored and processed only within the United States") or is an operational commitment sufficient for now?
2) Retention: any required retention period for logs/audit trails? We default to 90 days for certain telemetry but can be extended.
3) Support & SLA: order form lists "Standard" support. If they need guaranteed 24/7 response for Severity 1, we'll need to include an SLA exhibit and potential pricing adjustment.
4) Liability/indemnity cap: do we have a target cap (e.g., $X M or fees-based)? Helpful for commercial negotiation.

Plan: I'll draft redlines on the Redwood_MSA_Template_v3.1.docx and produce a redline package (MSA_redline_for_ACME.docx) plus a summary of material changes by Dec 2. If procurement confirms net 60 and provides billing contact, I'll include invoice/PO clauses accordingly.

Evelyn / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few answers:
- Billing/PO: billing contact is Laura.PO@acmetech.com and net 60 is standard; procurement will push for net 45 if possible but net 60 is acceptable.
- Data residency: we need contractually binding "Customer Data to be stored within US-based datacenters" language.
- Retention: 12 months for logs/audit copies, except aggregated anonymized metrics which can be longer.
- SLA: standard support is OK to start; we'll raise the question of a separate premium SLA later.

We're fine with you pushing your template and we'll mark any ACME-specific clauses we need preserved. Please send redlines by Dec 2. We can then arrange a legal-to-legal sync if needed.
